concerns.text: T020-impl (Latent Encoding) is marked [P] (parallel) but explicitly requires T014 (cache directory creation) and implicitly requires T007 (VAE Loader) and T008 (Ground Truth Labels) to exist before it can encode regions. T014 is in Phase 2.1, but T007/T008 are also in Phase 2.1. The task description says 'Requires T014 completion' but does not explicitly list T007/T008 as dependencies, creating a hidden ordering violation where T020-impl might be attempted before the VAE or Labels are ready.

T029-impl (Vector Arithmetic) is marked [P] but requires T027 (Linearity Verification) and T028 (Centroid Computation). T027 and T028 are listed in Phase 4.1 (Parallel Implementation). However, T028 explicitly depends on T020-run (Latent Vectors) and T008-run (Ground Truth). T020-run is in Phase 3.2 (Sequential). This creates a cross-phase dependency where a 'Parallel' task in Phase 4 depends on a 'Sequential' task in Phase 3. The [P] tag is incorrect; T029-impl cannot run in parallel with T027/T028 if those depend on Phase 3 completion.

T031b-impl (Keypoint Matching) requires T031a-impl (Mask Creation). T031a-impl is in Phase 4.1. T031b-impl is also in Phase 4.1. However, T031b-impl logic states it must 'Detect keypoints... in non-text regions (masked using create_non_text_mask from T031a-impl)'. If T031a-impl and T031b-impl are truly parallel, T031b-impl cannot access the output of T031a-impl. The [P] tag on T031b-impl is invalid; it must be sequential after T031a-impl.

T035-impl (Bonferroni Correction) requires T034-run, T023-impl, T030a-run, T031c-run. T023-impl (Permutation Test) is in Phase 3.2. T030a-run and T031c-run are in Phase 4.2. T034-run is in Phase 5.1. The task T035-impl is in Phase 5.1. The dependency chain is valid, but T035-impl is marked [P] in the list? No, it is not marked [P]. Wait, T035-impl is in Phase 5.1 which is 'Sequential Execution'. The concern is that T035-impl depends on T023-impl (Phase 3) and T030a-run (Phase 4). The ordering is correct, but the task description 'Requires T034-run, T023-impl...' mixes implementation tasks (T023-impl) with execution tasks (T030a-run). This is a semantic inconsistency in dependency definition, though not a hard ordering violation if the execution tasks are assumed to complete the impl tasks.

T000-impl is marked [P] but its logic 'Calculate minimum N required' depends on the 'Assumptions' section of the spec. While not a data artifact, the task description implies a dependency on the spec being finalized. More critically, T000-run depends on T000-impl. T000-impl is in Phase 0.1. T000-run is in Phase 0.2. This is correct. However, T000-impl is marked [P] alongside T002-impl. T002-impl depends on T000-run? No, T002b-run depends on T000-run. T002-impl is independent. The [P] tag is valid for T000-impl and T002-impl relative to each other.

T008b-impl (Heuristic Label Derivation) is marked [P] but its logic 'Derive... from ground-truth bounding box fields' implies it needs the ground-truth data. T008-impl (Ground-Truth Label Extraction) is also in Phase 2.1. T008b-impl depends on the *output* of T008-impl (the bounding box fields). If T008-impl and T008b-impl are parallel, T008b-impl cannot run until T008-impl produces the data. The [P] tag is invalid; T008b-impl must be sequential after T008-impl.
